definitions.explanation: A bird living in its natural habitat, as opposed to domesticated or caged birds. Used in the context of birdwatching, nature conservation, and ecology.

examples.japanese: {公園|こうえん}で{野鳥|やちょう}を{観察|かんさつ}する。
examples.english: Observe wild birds in the park.

examples.japanese: この{湿地|しっち}には{多|おお}くの{野鳥|やちょう}が{飛来|ひらい}する。
examples.english: Many wild birds migrate to this wetland.

examples.japanese: {双眼鏡|そうがんきょう}を{持|も}って{野鳥|やちょう}の{会|かい}の{観察会|かんさつかい}に{参加|さんか}した。
examples.english: I brought binoculars and joined a wild bird society observation event.

notes:
Refers to birds that live in the wild, as opposed to {飼|か}い{鳥|どり} (pet birds) or {家禽|かきん} (poultry).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {野鳥|やちょう}{観察|かんさつ} (birdwatching)
- {野鳥|やちょう}の{会|かい} (wild bird society)
- {野鳥|やちょう}{保護|ほご} (wild bird conservation)
- {野鳥|やちょう}{図鑑|ずかん} (wild bird field guide)

The {日本野鳥|にほんやちょう}の{会|かい} (Wild Bird Society of Japan) is a well-known conservation organization. Birdwatching ({野鳥|やちょう}{観察|かんさつ} or バードウォッチング) is a popular hobby in Japan.
